method: One bounded damping multiplier per partial and soft/hard endpoint. Medium poles and C5 endpoints stay fixed.

analysis.time_check: Later disjoint windows, separated by 200 ms; used to retain or reject candidates, not a blind test.
analysis.native_selection: Retain only changes that also reduce native partial decay error by at least 0.10 dB in both time regions.

native_result.scope: Errors cover retained partials and above-noise frames, after per-partial attack normalization. Both time regions informed selection; this is not a blind test.

limits: The reference library supplies strike labels, not measured hammer speeds or release times.
